g.text: Each dot is one planned native trajectory; boxes show quartiles, median and observed range.
Counts use the 15s WSL monotonic cutoff. Known cost includes late requests and drain settlement.
Gray x: unstarted; black X: incomplete fees. Both are excluded from boxes; liabilities are tabulated.
Costs are usage-based estimates, not invoices. The common-state cohort is reported separately.
